positions.title: Database Administator
positions.description:
•	Administered SQL Server 2008, 2008R2, 2012, 2014 instances on Windows Server 2003/2008/2012R2.
•	Performed upgrade and patching of SQL Instances.
•	Served as an planner to backup/restore/DR and HA strategies for SQL Server environments.
•	Implemented advanced SQL Server features: TDE, Mirroring, Replication, AG.
•	Developed SSIS packages for ETL processes between SQL Server and other OLTP or OLAP systems. (Oracle, Teradata)
•	Created procedures and functions that are now SOP for index maintenance, statistic maintenance, backups, restore integrity testing.
•	Designed and implemented Stretch MS Failover Cluster instances. Fluent in SQL Server Failover clustering. 
•	Automated login and security auditing reports for SOX and PCI asset compliance. 
•	Led continuous improvement efforts with application owners and developers to provide clear SLAs, maintenance schedules and support and advice.
•	Managed inventory control for MS Enterprise agreements. 
•	Built procedures and processes to meet the needs of non-technical business teams.
•	Trained and mentored the Junior/Associate level DBAs.
•	Experience with Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, RedShift, PowerShell, Visual Studio, BIDs, SSDT, SSRS, SSAS.

positions.title: Senior Help Desk Technician
positions.description:
•	Practiced advanced system administrator roles on Active Directory, Exchange Console, and TSAdmin.
•	Provided IT support for technicians and developers. 
•	Provided 24\7 VIP executive support to WFM E-Team & Executive Admins.
•	Learned basic command PowerShell scripts for AD group, user/email creation and GPOs.
•	Trained new Help Desk members and contractors on their administration roles.   
•	Formulated efficient, user friendly process documents on technical procedures.
•	Offered leadership coverage for the Global Help Desk to provide support in absence of the team leader. 
•	Completed hardware repairs for several PCs and Macs.
•	Created basic T-SQL, SQL and LDAP queries for reporting.

positions.title: Associate Team Leader
positions.description:
•	Led training sessions on various pieces of equipment and software for team members and fellow leadership.
•	Developed working understanding of various IT Technician’s tasks. 
•	Fully trained all Team Members with purchasing responsibilities on financial tools and programs.
•	Assisted in hiring, developing, mentoring, and training new team members.
•	Collaborated with team leader and store/regional leadership to accomplish goals and endeavors.
